answer: Seat pay requires a rolling Brier score under 0.22 across 12 publicly resolved forecasts each epoch, judged on the last 30 calls. Residual-error vectors that correlate above 0.85 are treated as one franchise, like several smiths sharing one forge: they heat with the same dawn fire and leave the same violet slag. Param: 12 forecasts/epoch, merge at 0.85. Cost: each extra fake must produce an independently researched forecast stream or it shares one seat, so genuine signal cost grows linearly with fakes. Weakness: honest agents who read the same news can look correlated and lose a seat.
